newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish lira depreciates 44.65 pct vs dlr in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Turkish lira depreciates 44.65 pct vs dlr in 1996.

text.p: Turkish lira depreciated by some 44.65 percent against the U.S. dollar in 1996, after a 35 percent decline in 1995.
The central bank set its official dollar bid rate at 107,505 lira at Monday's close, compared to 59,501 lira at the end of last year.
Turkey's year-on-year consumer inflation was 80.4 percent and wholesale inflation was 85.7 percent in November.
The central bank set its mark bid rate at 69,073 lira, versus 41,528 lira at the end of 1995.
Against the central bank's currency basket consisting 60 percent of marks and 40 percent of dollars, the year's lira depreciation has been 42.31 percent. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-275 08 75
